concerns.text: FR-010 (compute feature‑importance scores such as SHAP for both molecular and framework attributes) is not referenced by any phase or script in the implementation plan.
SC-007 (feature‑importance report must list at least the top five molecular and top five framework features with SHAP values) has no corresponding plan element.
SC-008 (stratified CV must use gas‑type stratification and be verified) is not explicitly addressed in any plan phase; only SC-009 and SC-006 are mentioned.
SC-011 (late‑fusion baseline must be trained and reported, with its RMSE compared to other baselines) is missing from the plan’s mapping; baselines.py lists FR‑011 but does not list SC‑011.
